Source: Dungeons and Dragon Ballz V.3, PDF page 131. Category: technique. Rank 1.

Rank 1 Weapon technique
Ki Cost: 8 ki
Casting Prerequisite: 1 Simple or Martial Weapon
that you are proficient with.
Casting Time: 1 Action
Range: Self
Chargeable?: Yes
Duration: Instantaneous
A ki-charged weapon strike. Roll a combo attack roll,
dealing your equipped melee weapon’s damage die +
2d6 damage on a hit.
